values: Off Grid iOS ↔ macOS Sync Manual Gate
Release scope: iOS and macOS only. Update Status and Evidence as physical testing progresses.

iOS → macOS: chat/project sync, messages, thinking, tool results, generated tool artifacts, knowledge document sync and generic file sync. macOS Replay capture toggle ↔ menu-bar state is also verified.
Shared ambient-directory source is consumed by both hosts. Desktop Pro is d1b6f9d/7c126fe; Mobile Pro is 1665fc43/98be179c and current iOS is physically installed. Manual verification remains.
No known coding blocker remains in this matrix. Cmd+[ / Cmd+] history is implemented and is ready for manual verification.
The five-device hard cap requires a physical multi-device setup.
